A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TC-Padé and contain readable main texts, equations, tables, figures, and complete supplements. Relocated material can be matched reliably across versions.

before.justification: v1 reports original image/video generation experiments, ablations, deployment measurements, and a 50-participant user study in its main text and supplement.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–8 and the supplementary user study.

M1.justification: The residual predictor, TSI computation gate, adaptive coefficients, and three-phase denoising strategy remain unchanged. Equations 1–9 specify the same procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same COCO 2017, ImageNet, DrawBench, VBench-2.0, and Parti-prompt coverage, including the same multi-resolution examples. Newly cited application domains are background references, not additional evaluations.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same ToCa, Δ-DiT, TeaCache, and TaylorSeer configurations and unaccelerated baselines. The quantization comparison and user-study comparator set also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported sampling budgets, metrics, model configurations, 50,000 COCO prompts, ImageNet sampling procedure, and 50-participant blind study are unchanged. Moving experiments into the supplement introduces no new protocol.

E4.justification: Residual-granularity and TSI-threshold ablations move from main Section 4.3 to supplementary Section 6.2 without alteration. Sensitivity analysis, quantization/scaling analysis, trajectory comparisons, and qualitative cases are also retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed-based variability, confidence intervals, or significance tests for these experiments. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or removed.

E6.justification: Tables 1–8 and corresponding graphical and qualitative results retain their values and findings. Examples include FLUX's 2.88× speedup, Wan's 60.38% VBench-2.0 score, DiT's 6.93 FID, and the 45% user preference for TC-Padé.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations remain identical. The coefficient-design reasoning moves from supplementary Section 7 to Section 8 without substantive revision; no theorem, proof, or derivation is added.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution list retain the same claims about rational residual forecasting, step-aware prediction, and low-step acceleration. The shortened conclusion preserves their substantive scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of residual stability, threshold trade-offs, sensitivity-related artifacts, and compatibility with quantization are retained. The new main-text ablation summary restates existing interpretations, and no substantive limitation is added.

D1.justification: Both versions disclose the same NVIDIA L40/PyTorch setup, λ = 10, TSI thresholds, sampling details, and use of public baseline implementations. No additional implementation or code/data access information is provided.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 broadens from diffusion acceleration to visual generation, adding autoregressive models and application context. Eleven references are added, including PixelSNAIL, ZipAR, Diffusion Probe, SimplePoster, and ShoeFit; supplementary Section 9 adds further application citations. Positioning against caching methods remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The experimental narrative is reorganized: detailed ablations and deployment discussion move into new supplementary Section 6, while main Section 4.3 becomes a brief summary. Other edits expand Section 2.1, shorten the conclusion, update affiliations, and correct the overview reference from Figure 12 to Figure 3.

P2.justification: Tables 4–6 and Figures 5–6 move from the main text into the supplement, substantially rearranging the presentation of supporting evidence. v2 also adds Alibaba Security/Yuvion headers throughout and adjusts some qualitative-panel sizing. All scientific figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: Correcting the overview reference and adding background provide small editorial benefits. The substantial reorganization preserves the same scientific evidence and explanations, while the new application citations add limited insight into TC-Padé itself. Considering both complete PDFs, these changes do not materially improve or diminish overall paper quality.
